name: Misumi Karin
source:
A half-Japanese girl who calls herself the protagonist's sex slave. She has plain, homely, and innocent-looking features, but upon closer inspection, she possesses the appearance of a beautiful girl.

She has slightly droopy eyes, wears glasses, has freckles, and wears her blonde hair in braids. She has a plump figure with huge breasts, and her short stature makes her chest size stand out even more.

She has a quiet and polite personality, yet is extremely lewd. She is utterly devoted to the protagonist and willingly obeys even the most obscene demands. She particularly delights in verbal abuse and enjoys using dirty talk to degrade herself. 

She unabashedly claims that being the protagonist's sex slave is her greatest happiness. It's hard to tell what she truly thinks inside. Occasionally, she flashes a chillingly wicked smile.

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf013/character.html]official site[/url]]
